stations.name: Seoul Station (KTX / AREX / Subway Lines 1 & 4)
stations.arex_express_location: B2 - B7 (Underground Airport Railroad concourse). Follow orange 'Airport Railroad Express' signs.
stations.wowpass_tmoney_location: WOWPASS Kiosks located near AREX gates (B2) and Subway Line 1 concourse. T-money recharge at any subway ticket machine (cash only).

luggage_services.name: T-Luggage (Seoul Metro Official)
luggage_services.location: Underground passage between Exit 1 and Exit 2
luggage_services.cost: 9,000 KRW for 4 hrs (weekdays) / 13,000 KRW (weekends), +1,000 KRW/hr after
luggage_services.notes: Face-to-face counter, offers same-day hotel and airport luggage delivery.

luggage_services.name: Zimcarry (KORAIL KTX Official)
luggage_services.location: Main KTX concourse near 2nd floor shopping area
luggage_services.cost: 10,000 KRW for 4 hrs, or ~15,000-20,000 KRW for same-day delivery to Busan/hotel
luggage_services.notes: Best service for forwarding heavy bags from Seoul Station directly to your Busan hotel!

luggage_services.name: T-Locker / LuggageQ (24/7 Coin Lockers)
luggage_services.location: Near Exit 15 and throughout B1 subway interchange
luggage_services.cost: ~1,000 KRW per hour per locker (one locker fits 2-3 large 27-inch suitcases)
luggage_services.notes: Self-service touchscreen kiosks with English interface. Pay by credit card or T-money.

stations.transfer_tip: When transferring from Subway Line 1 or 4 to KTX, allow at least 10-15 minutes to navigate the escalator concourses.

stations.name: Busan KTX Station & Busan Metro Line 1
stations.arex_express_location: N/A (Use Gimhae Light Rail or Airport Limousine Bus for Gimhae Airport)
stations.wowpass_tmoney_location: WOWPASS Kiosk inside 2nd floor KTX waiting hall. T-money/Busan Metro machines on B1.

luggage_services.name: Zimcarry Busan Station Desk
luggage_services.location: 2nd floor KTX waiting hall near Exit 1
luggage_services.cost: ~15,000 KRW per large suitcase for hotel delivery or airport transfer
luggage_services.notes: Drop your suitcases when your KTX arrives at 11:30 AM and go straight to Haeundae Beach empty-handed! Bags arrive at your hotel by 4 PM.

stations.transfer_tip: Exit 1 on the 2nd floor leads to the pedestrian deck and Busan Metro Line 1 (Orange Line) entrance.

stations.name: Singyeongju Station (Gyeongju KTX / SRT)
stations.category: High-Speed Rail Gateway to Historic Gyeongju
stations.wowpass_tmoney_location: Convenience store (StoryWay / CU) inside station hall.

luggage_services.name: Singyeongju Station Luggage Lockers
luggage_services.location: Main waiting hall to the right of the exit gates
luggage_services.notes: Coin/card lockers. Ideal if you want to explore Bulguksa Temple before checking into your hotel.

stations.transfer_tip: Exit 1 leads directly to the bus terminal for Bus #700 and the official Kakao T taxi stand.

stations.name: Incheon International Airport (ICN - T1 / T2)
stations.arex_express_location: Transportation Center (B1) in both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
stations.wowpass_tmoney_location: WOWPASS Kiosks located in Arrivals Hall (1F) and AREX ticket area (B1). CU/GS25 convenience stores sell T-money cards.

luggage_services.name: Hanjin Express / Airport Baggage Delivery
luggage_services.location: Terminal 1 (3F near check-in counter B/N) and Terminal 2 (1F/3F)
luggage_services.cost: ~15,000 - 25,000 KRW per suitcase for same-day hotel delivery in Seoul
luggage_services.notes: Drop bags after landing and ride AREX to Seoul empty-handed.

stations.transfer_tip: If flying Korean Air or Asiana on Day 23 departure, use the Seoul Station City Airport Terminal (B2) to check your luggage and clear immigration downtown before boarding AREX!
